problem_statement:
SaturatedSliceIter::next has overflow bug
```sh
$ cargo run Lib/test/test_list.py -v -k test_extendedslicing

test_extendedslicing (__main__.ListTest) ... thread 'main' panicked at 'attempt to add with overflow', vm/src/builtins/slice.rs:377:9
```

Probably introduced in #3340
setup_command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Install Python test dependencies without using sudo or virtualenv
python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

# Install pytest and packages required by the repository test suites
# Some tests have requirements files; install them if present
if [ -f extra_tests/requirements.txt ]; then
    python3 -m pip install -r extra_tests/requirements.txt
fi
if [ -f wasm/tests/requirements.txt ]; then
    python3 -m pip install -r wasm/tests/requirements.txt
fi

# Also ensure pytest is installed (provides --junitxml)
python3 -m pip install pytest

# Ensure junit xml support (pytest has it builtin) and any useful plugins
python3 -m pip install junit-xml || true

# Print installed packages for debugging
python3 -m pip freeze

cargo fetch --locked
